active.description: whether the hook is enabled (default true)

events.description: event types (task.created, task.modified, task.completed, task.deleted, task.started, task.stopped, task.reopened, task.assigned, task.unassigned, task.blocked, task.due_changed, task.priority_changed, task.project_changed, task.tags_changed, task.unblocked, project.archived, project.annotated, project.denotated)

project.description: project slug in the effective workspace

sink.description: workspace notification sink name or ID

workspace.description: workspace slug or UUID; omit to use the actor's default workspace
